messages.author: Aino Asentaja
messages.text:
Hi Pekka, at TRN-051. New SFP in on ge-0/0/1. Link is up and alarms are gone but there's no traffic.
Should I swap the SFP again?

messages.author: Pekka Päivystäjä
messages.text: Hold on. Same kind of thing came up on TRN-042 last week. Erkki's advice was to look at the counters first. Are they moving?

messages.author: Aino Asentaja
messages.text: Link UP, RX power normal, counters at zero.

messages.author: Pekka Päivystäjä
messages.text: Then disable the interface, wait a bit and enable it. No reboot yet.

messages.author: Aino Asentaja
messages.text: Done. Traffic is back on TRN-051.
